SwitchPreference.android:title: Shortcut on Toolbar
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Show the translation panel button in the keyboard toolbar

ListPreference.android:title: Translation AI Provider
ListPreference.android:summary: Choose which AI configuration to query for translations

EditTextPreference.android:title: AI Custom Prompt
EditTextPreference.android:summary: Custom instruction used when translating text via AI. Supports [Language] and [Text].
EditTextPreference.android:defaultValue: Translate the following text to [Language]. Output ONLY the translated text. Do not include any explanations, warnings, headers, greetings, markdown blocks, or surrounding quotes:\n\n[Text]

Preference.android:title: Free Offline Translation RAM/Storage
Preference.android:summary: Deletes all downloaded local ML Kit translation models to reclaim space and RAM (~30MB+ per model).
